title: FFT Butterfly
description: Visualization of the FFT butterfly algorithm showing how the Fast Fourier Transform breaks down signal computation into stages.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Algorithms
Butterfly Diagram
learningObjectives: Trace how data indices are reordered from one butterfly stage to the next by stepping through the algorithm with the Start/Next Step button
Calculate the number of butterfly stages for a given FFT size as log base 2 of N, and verify it against the stage counter
Predict how doubling the FFT size with the radio buttons adds exactly one additional stage to the diagram
Explain how the divide-and-conquer structure of the butterfly reduces the transform cost from N squared to N log N operations
Identify the crossing pairs of connection lines at each stage as the butterfly combinations that give the diagram its name
